subject.title: feat: discover OpenCode and Pi sessions on paired nodes

question: Should bundled and trusted-official plugins be allowed to replace a narrower caller's scopes for node invocation, and should these local-history catalogs activate and discover sessions by default on upgrade?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes a shared authorization boundary and begins default-on discovery of locally stored session history; code inspection cannot determine the repository's desired trust and upgrade policy.

options.title: Narrow authority before landing
options.body: Keep the plugin catalogs but restrict synthetic node authority to the minimum read-only contract and require an explicit decision for default-on discovery.

options.title: Accept the trusted-plugin contract
options.body: Approve scope replacement and enabled-by-default discovery as intentional behavior for bundled and trusted-official plugins, with upgrade documentation and final-head proof.

options.title: Split the Gateway policy change
options.body: Move the generic scope-replacement behavior into a separately reviewed security-boundary PR before landing the catalog feature.

recommendation.title: Narrow authority before landing
recommendation.body: Keep the plugin catalogs but restrict synthetic node authority to the minimum read-only contract and require an explicit decision for default-on discovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and linked canonical issue place this person closest to both the feature direction and the Gateway/plugin ownership boundary.
